subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should maintainers split this issue so Feishu outbound hook parity is fixed first while normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening is tracked separately?
rationale: The Feishu outbound gap is a documented hook-coverage bug, but broadening `inbound_claim` changes pre-routing claim authority for all normal channel traffic and needs maintainer API/security intent.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
options.body: Fix Feishu outbound `message_sending` coverage through the existing dispatcher/hook seam and move normal-channel `inbound_claim` to a separate review track.

options.title: Fold into outbound-hook canonical work
options.body: Keep this issue as Feishu evidence while an existing broader outbound-hook PR or issue owns the actual outbound repair.

options.title: Solve all hook requests together
options.body: Use one larger design PR for outbound parity and normal inbound claiming, accepting higher compatibility and security review cost.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu outbound `message_sending` coverage through the existing dispatcher/hook seam and move normal-channel `inbound_claim` to a separate review track.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision includes `inbound_claim` and plugin-owned binding semantics from the plugin-surface work they authored.
